title: 第十三章 血沸
content_zh:
那碗清水带来的力量短暂而虚假。坐不到半刻钟，失血和剧痛引发的寒意与虚弱，便如潮水般再次涌上。右肩的伤口在简陋包扎下依旧一跳一跳地疼，每一次心跳都像在拉扯着伤口边缘，带来清晰的锐痛。陈默脸色苍白，额头渗出细密的冷汗，在午后闷热潮湿的空气里，却觉得四肢百骸都在发冷。

    但他没有挪动，只是将背脊更紧地贴在冰凉的石墩上，借此汲取一丝微弱的热量消散感。他闭上眼睛，排除掉周围嘈杂的议论、呼喝、金铁交鸣声，将所有注意力集中在体内。

    那缕暖流变得比之前更加微弱，仿佛风中残烛，在空旷的丹田和受损的经脉中艰难游移。他不再尝试将其导向受伤的右肩——那里气血紊乱，贸然引导可能适得其反。他只是极其缓慢、轻柔地运行着最基础的《引气诀》周天，让那微弱的暖意在固定的、未受伤的经脉路径中，一遍遍流转，如同用最细的刷子，一遍遍梳理着干涸的河道，试图重新聚拢散乱的气血，也试图在持续的、几乎要将他淹没的疼痛和虚弱中，守住灵台最后一丝清明。

    呼吸，被他刻意放得绵长，再绵长。每一次吸气，都仿佛要用尽全身力气，将弥漫在广场上的、混杂着尘土、血腥和汗水气息的空气，压入肺腑深处；每一次吐气，都努力将体内的寒意、痛楚、还有那不受控制滋生的恐惧和眩晕，一并排出。

    很艰难。剧痛像无数细小的钩子，不断撕扯着他的意识，试图将他拖入黑暗。失血带来的虚弱感，则让他觉得身体沉重如铅，连抬起眼皮都费力。

    但他坚持着。一呼，一吸。一吸，一呼。

    不知过了多久，或许只有几十息，或许有一炷香。当他再次勉强睁开眼时，视野里晃动的重影略微减轻了一些，虽然依旧模糊，但至少能看清不远处石台上交错的人影，和台下攒动的人头。耳边的嘈杂声也重新变得清晰，只是仿佛隔着一层厚重的毛玻璃。

    “……甲字九台，丁字一百零五，对丙字四十一！”

    唱号声再次响起，又一组人被命运推上石台。

    陈默的目光，下意识地投向离自己最近的一座石台。台上，一个和他一样穿着粗布短褂、但身形明显壮实许多的杂役少年，正挥舞着一根沉重的熟铜棍，与一名手持分水刺的外门弟子战在一处。那杂役少年力大势沉，铜棍舞动起来虎虎生风，显然是下过苦功的，但动作略显笨拙，灵力波动微弱。而他的对手，那外门弟子身法灵活，分水刺如同毒蛇吐信，每每从铜棍的间隙中钻入，在那杂役少年身上留下浅浅的血痕。不过十来个回合，杂役少年便因多处受伤，动作迟滞，被那外门弟子抓住破绽，一刺点在手腕，铜棍脱手，随即被一脚踹中小腹，惨叫着跌下石台，摔在地上半天爬不起来。

    又输了。毫不意外。

    陈默的目光从那痛苦蜷缩的杂役少年身上移开，扫过其他石台。相似的场景在不断上演。“丁”字组对“丁”字组，是蛮力与血勇的碰撞，往往两败俱伤。“丁”字组对“丙”字组，则大多是单方面的压制，偶有挣扎，也很快如浪花般湮灭。那些外门弟子，哪怕只是入门一两年的，在功法、武技、灵力运用乃至战斗意识上，都全面碾压杂役。这是资源、传承和起点决定的鸿沟，并非单纯的血气之勇可以填补。

    自己能赢下赵明，三分靠那近乎自残的悍勇和精准的反击，三分靠对手的轻敌和焦躁，或许，还有四分说不清道不明的、在无数次枯燥磨砺中沉淀下来的，对自身力量和痛苦极限的掌控。但这份“掌控”，在绝对的实力差距和重伤之下，还能剩下几分？

    下一轮，自己还能站起来吗？就算站起来，还能挥得动柴刀吗？

    陈默不知道。他也不去想。想，无用。

    他只是再次闭上眼睛，将注意力转回体内，继续那缓慢到近乎凝滞的呼吸吐纳。右肩的伤口，在每一次呼吸牵动胸廓时，都传来清晰的刺痛，提醒着他伤势的严重。但他努力将这种痛楚，也纳入“感知”的一部分，而不是让它彻底主宰神智。

    时间，在剧痛、虚弱和嘈杂的背景音中，一点点流逝。

    陆续有比试结束。胜者或欢呼，或平静下台；败者或被搀扶，或被抬走。广场上弥漫着越来越浓的血腥气和汗水味，混合着沉闷空气中的土腥，令人作呕。铅灰色的天空压得更低，云层翻滚，隐隐有雷声传来，但雨始终未下，只是让这方天地更加闷热窒息。

    忽然，一阵不同寻常的喧哗从广场另一侧传来，其中夹杂着几声明显的惊呼和赞叹。

    陈默勉强抬起眼皮，循声望去。只见“甲”字区域，一座位置较为靠前、似乎也更受关注些的石台上，比试似乎格外激烈。台上，一青一白两道身影正在快速交错。青色的，自然是外门弟子。而那道白色身影，却让陈默微微一怔。

    那是一个少女。

    看年纪，不过十四五岁，比他还要小些。穿着一身洗得发白的粗布衣裙，样式简单，甚至有些不合身，袖口和裙摆都短了一截，露出纤细的手腕和脚踝。头发用一根同色的布条松松束在脑后，几缕碎发被汗水贴在额角。她手中没有兵器，只是一双看起来纤细白皙的手掌，此刻却翻飞如蝶，掌缘隐隐有淡白色的微光流转，灵动迅捷，竟将对面一名手持长剑、气息明显达到炼气四层左右的青衣弟子，逼得有些手忙脚乱！

    那青衣弟子剑法不弱，灵力也颇为凝实，剑光霍霍，带着破风锐响。但那白衣少女身法极为奇特，看似轻盈飘逸，每每能在间不容发之际避开剑锋，步伐转折间毫无烟火气，仿佛穿花拂柳。她的掌法更是精妙，看似轻飘飘浑不着力，但每当与长剑相交，便发出“噗”的闷响，那青衣弟子手中的长剑竟会微微一偏，剑势也随之滞涩一瞬。

    “是‘流云掌’！还有‘柳絮随风步’！”台下有人低呼，“这女孩是谁？杂役院的？怎么可能会外门的中阶武学？”

    “好像不是咱们宗门的……看衣服像是山下镇子的？难道是新入门的弟子？可怎么分在‘丁’字组？”

    “不对，她身上没有灵力波动！或者……极其微弱隐晦！但掌法步法造诣如此之高……”

    议论声纷纷。陈默也看得心中微震。那少女的掌法步法，确实精妙，远超赵明之流，甚至比方才看到的其他“丙”字组弟子还要高明。而且，她似乎并未动用多少灵力，全凭精妙的招式和对战机的把握，就将一个炼气四层的对手压制住。这份战斗才情，堪称惊人。

    台上，那青衣弟子久攻不下，脸上有些挂不住，低喝一声，长剑上青光暴涨，使出了一招威力颇大的剑诀，剑光如瀑，笼罩向少女周身。

    少女神色不变，脚下步伐更快，如风拂弱柳，在剑光缝隙间穿梭而过，同时一双玉掌幻出数道残影，拍、按、拂、引，竟将凌厉的剑光引得偏向一旁。就在青衣弟子招式用老、新力未生之际，少女身形一晃，如鬼魅般切入对方中宫，右手食指中指并拢，快如闪电，在青衣弟子持剑手臂的“曲池穴”上轻轻一点。

    这一点，看似轻描淡写。但那青衣弟子却如遭电击，整条右臂瞬间酸麻无力，长剑“哐当”一声脱手落地。少女得势不饶人，左掌紧随其后，印在对方仓促抬起的左臂上，将其震得连退数步，一屁股跌坐在石台边缘，差点摔下去。

    胜负已分。

    灰衣执事上前，宣布结果：“甲字一台，丁字二百零一，苏芸，胜！”

    苏芸。陈默默念了一遍这个名字。原来她叫苏芸。丁字二百零一，和自己一样，是“杂役”或附属人员。可她展现出的实力，哪里像个杂役？

    那名叫苏芸的少女，听到宣布结果，脸上并无多少喜色，只是平静地对灰衣执事和台下点了点头，然后走过去，捡起地上那柄长剑，递还给脸色阵红阵白、兀自坐在地上的青衣弟子。

    青衣弟子咬着牙，接过剑，一言不发地爬起身，狠狠瞪了苏芸一眼，转身冲下台，挤入人群。

    苏芸对此浑不在意，只是轻轻拍了拍手上并不存在的灰尘，然后静静立在台边，等待下一轮的安排。她微微侧头，目光似乎无意间扫过广场，在陈默这个方向停留了极短暂的一瞬。

    距离很远，陈默看不清她的表情，只觉得那目光似乎清澈平静，又仿佛带着一丝与这喧嚣血腥场景格格不入的……疏离。

    就在这时，一道略显尖锐的唱号声，穿透了嘈杂，传入陈默耳中，让他刚刚因观察苏芸而略微分散的心神，猛地一凛！

    “丙字三台，丁字七十九，陈默，对丙字九，王炎！”

    又来了。

    而且，对手是丙字九。编号如此靠前，意味着在外门新弟子中，实力排名不低。炼气四层？还是更高？

    右肩的伤口，随着他心神震动，传来一阵更剧烈的抽痛，刚刚因调息而略微压下的眩晕感，也再次上涌。
content_en:
The power brought by that bowl of water is short-lived and false.Less than half an hour after sitting down, the chill and weakness caused by blood loss and severe pain surged up again like a tide.The wound on his right shoulder was still painful despite the crude bandage. Every heartbeat seemed to be pulling on the edge of the wound, causing clear and sharp pain.Chen Mo's face was pale, and fine cold sweat broke out on his forehead. In the hot and humid afternoon air, he felt that his limbs were chilling.
But he didn't move, he just pressed his back closer to the cold stone pier, thereby absorbing a faint sense of heat dissipation.He closed his eyes, eliminated the noisy discussions, shouts, and the sound of gold and iron around him, and focused all his attention on his body.
The warm current became weaker than before, like a candle in the wind, struggling to move through the empty Dantian and damaged meridians.He no longer tried to direct it to his injured right shoulder—the energy and blood there were disordered, and rash guidance might be counterproductive.He just ran the most basic "Qi-Entraining Technique" extremely slowly and gently, letting the weak warmth flow over and over in the fixed and uninjured meridians, just like using the finest brush to comb the dry river over and over again, trying to gather the scattered qi and blood again, and also trying to guard the last trace of clarity on the spiritual platform amidst the continuous pain and weakness that almost overwhelmed him.
His breathing was deliberately made longer and longer.Every time he inhaled, he seemed to use all his strength to press the air that was filled with dust, blood, and sweat in the square into the depths of his lungs; every time he exhaled, he tried to expel the chill, pain, and uncontrollable fear and dizziness from his body.
It's tough.The severe pain was like countless tiny hooks, constantly tearing at his consciousness, trying to drag him into the darkness.The weakness caused by blood loss made his body feel as heavy as lead, and it was difficult to even raise his eyelids.
But he persisted.One exhale, one inhale.One breath, one breath.
I don’t know how long it took, maybe only a few dozen breaths, maybe a stick of incense.When he reluctantly opened his eyes again, the shaking double images in his field of vision were slightly lessened. Although it was still blurry, he could at least clearly see the intertwined figures on the stone platform not far away and the crowd of heads below the stage.The noise in his ears became clear again, but it seemed like it was separated by a thick layer of frosted glass.
"...A means nine platforms, D means one hundred and five, and C means forty-one!"
The trumpets sounded again, and another group of people were pushed onto the stone platform by fate.
Chen Mo's eyes subconsciously turned to the stone platform closest to him.On the stage, a young handyman wearing a coarse cloth jacket like him, but with a much stronger figure, was wielding a heavy wrought copper rod and fighting with an outer disciple holding a water-splitting spear.The young handyman's strength was very low, and the copper stick danced vigorously. It was obvious that he had worked hard, but his movements were a little clumsy and his spiritual power fluctuated weakly.As for his opponent, the outer disciple was nimble in his movements, and his water-splitting thorns were like poisonous snakes spitting messages. He always got through the gaps in the copper rods, leaving shallow blood stains on the body of the handyman boy.After only ten rounds, the young handyman was injured in many places and his movements were sluggish. The outer disciple caught the flaw and stabbed his wrist. The copper rod fell out of his hand, and then he was kicked in the lower abdomen. He screamed and fell off the stone platform. He fell to the ground and couldn't get up for a long time.
Lost again.No surprise.
Chen Mo moved his eyes away from the painful young handyman and scanned the other stone platforms.Similar scenes continue to play out.The "D" character group versus the "D" character group is a collision of brute force and bloody courage, and both sides are often hurt.The "D" character group versus the "C" character group is mostly unilaterally suppressed. There are occasional struggles, but they are quickly annihilated like waves.Those outer sect disciples, even those who have only been involved for a year or two, can completely crush the handymen in terms of martial arts, martial arts, use of spiritual power and even combat consciousness.This is a gap determined by resources, inheritance and starting point, and cannot be filled by pure courage.
He could defeat Zhao Ming, three points by his almost self-inflicted bravery and precise counterattacks, three points by his opponent's underestimation and impatience, and perhaps four points by the inexplicable control of his own strength and the limits of pain that had been accumulated through countless boring trials.But how much of this "control" can be left despite the absolute strength gap and serious injuries?
Can you still stand up in the next round?Even if you stand up, can you still swing the hatchet?
Chen Mo didn't know.He didn't think about it either.Think, useless.
He just closed his eyes again, turned his attention back to his body, and continued his breathing that was so slow that it was almost stagnant.The wound on his right shoulder sent a clear stinging pain every time he took a breath, reminding him of the seriousness of the injury.But he tried hard to include this pain as part of his "perception" instead of letting it completely dominate his mind.
Time passed little by little amid severe pain, weakness and noisy background sounds.
The competitions are ending one after another.The winner may cheer or calmly step down; the loser may be supported or carried away.The square was filled with an increasingly dense smell of blood and sweat, mixed with the earthy smell in the dull air, which was nauseating.The leaden sky was lower, the clouds were rolling, and there was a faint sound of thunder, but the rain never fell, which only made the world more sultry and suffocating.
Suddenly, an unusual noise came from the other side of the square, mixed with several obvious exclamations and admirations.
Chen Mo reluctantly raised his eyelids and looked around.In the "A" area, there is a stone platform that is located closer to the front and seems to attract more attention. The competition seems to be particularly fierce.On the stage, two figures, one green and one white, were rapidly intersecting.The cyan ones are naturally the outer disciples.But that white figure made Chen Mo slightly startled.
That's a girl.
Judging by his age, he was only fourteen or fifteen years old, slightly younger than him.She was wearing a coarse cloth dress that had been washed white. The style was simple and even a little ill-fitting. The cuffs and skirt were shortened, exposing her slender wrists and ankles.Her hair was tied loosely behind her head with a piece of cloth of the same color, and a few strands of hair were stuck to her forehead with sweat.There was no weapon in her hand, just a pair of slender and white-looking palms. At this moment, they were flying like butterflies. There was a faint white light flowing around the edges of the palms. They were so agile and quick that they actually forced a disciple in Tsing Yi opposite who was holding a long sword and whose aura had obviously reached the fourth level of Qi Refining to be in a hurry!
The Tsing Yi disciple's swordsmanship was not weak, and his spiritual power was quite solid. His sword was blazing brightly, with a sharp sound of breaking wind.But the movement of the girl in white is extremely strange, seemingly light and elegant, she can always avoid the edge of the sword at the last moment, and there is no fireworks in the turns of her steps, as if she is walking through flowers and willows.Her palm technique was even more exquisite, seemingly light and effortless, but whenever it intersected with the long sword, there would be a muffled "pop" sound, and the long sword in the hand of the disciple in green would sway slightly, and the sword force would be stagnant for a moment.
"It's the 'Floating Cloud Palm'! And the 'Catkin Walking with the Wind'!" Someone in the audience whispered, "Who is this girl? She is from the Servant Academy? How can she know the intermediate martial arts of the outer sect?"
"It doesn't seem like he's from our sect... His clothes look like he's from the town at the foot of the mountain? Is he a new disciple? How come he's in the 'D' group?"
"No, there is no spiritual power fluctuation in her body! Or... it is extremely weak and obscure! But her palm skills and footwork are so accomplished..."
There was a lot of discussion.Chen Mo was also slightly shocked.The girl's palm skills and footwork were indeed exquisite, far superior to those of Zhao Ming and others, and even better than the other disciples of the "C" group that I just saw.Moreover, she didn't seem to use much spiritual power. She suppressed an opponent at the fourth level of Qi refining solely by relying on her exquisite moves and grasp of the fighter's timing.This fighting talent is amazing.
On the stage, the disciple in green couldn't attack for a long time, and his face was a little confused. He shouted lowly, the green light on the long sword surged, and he used a powerful sword technique. The sword light was like a waterfall, covering the girl's body.
The girl's expression remained unchanged, her steps were faster, and she passed through the gaps in the sword light like the wind blowing on a weak willow. At the same time, a pair of jade palms phantomed several afterimages, patting, pressing, brushing, and guiding them, and actually diverted the sharp sword light to one side.Just when the disciple in Tsing Yi was using his old and new strength in his moves, the girl swayed and cut into the opponent's middle palace like a ghost. The index and middle fingers of her right hand came together and, as fast as lightning, she tapped lightly on the "Quchi point" of the disciple in Tsing Yi's sword-holding arm.
This may seem like an understatement.But the Tsing Yi disciple felt as if he had been shocked by an electric shock. His entire right arm was instantly sore and numb, and the long sword fell to the ground with a clang.The girl's advantage was unforgiving, and her left palm followed closely, imprinting on the opponent's hastily raised left arm, causing him to take several steps back, and he fell to the edge of the stone platform, almost falling.
The outcome has been decided.
The deacon in gray clothes stepped forward and announced the result: "A means one, D means two hundred and one, Su Yun wins!"
Su Yun.Chen silently read the name again.It turns out her name is Su Yun.Ding Zi 201, like himself, is a "handyman" or ancillary staff.But how could she look like a handyman with the strength she showed?
When the girl named Su Yun heard the announcement of the result, she didn't have much joy on her face. She just nodded calmly to the deacon in gray and the audience. Then she walked over, picked up the long sword on the ground, and handed it back to the disciple in green who was sitting on the ground with his face red and white.
The Tsing Yi disciple gritted his teeth, took the sword, stood up without saying a word, glared at Su Yun, turned around, rushed off the stage, and squeezed into the crowd.
Su Yun didn't care about this, just patted the non-existent dust on her hands, and then stood quietly by the stage, waiting for the next round of arrangements.She tilted her head slightly and her eyes seemed to sweep across the square unintentionally, stopping in Chen Mo's direction for a very brief moment.
The distance was so far that Chen Mo couldn't see her expression clearly, but he felt that her eyes seemed clear and calm, and seemed to have a trace of... alienation that was incompatible with this noisy and bloody scene.
At this moment, a slightly sharp trumpet sound penetrated the noise and reached Chen Mo's ears. His mind, which had just been slightly distracted by observing Su Yun, suddenly froze!
"The word C is three, the number D is seventy-nine, Chen Mo, and the word C is nine, Wang Yan!"
here we go again.
Moreover, the opponent is C Zi Jiu.Being numbered so high means that among the new disciples of the outer sect, their strength ranks high.Fourth level of Qi refining?Or higher?
The wound on his right shoulder caused a more severe throbbing pain as his mind shook, and the dizziness that had been suppressed by the breath adjustment also surged up again.
